1 unité de Wrap
3 unité de medium eggs
45 g de Crumble
40 g de spinach, chopped Handful cherry tomatoes, halved Handful scallions, sliced Salt & pep
recipe.instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Line a small tin or dish with the wrap. Add ingredients Whisk the eggs, pour it in Bake for 20 mins.
